title: Lord's paradox
content: Sex affects both initial and final weight, and initial weight also affects final weight. Gain is deterministically Final Weight minus Initial Weight. Initial Weight is therefore a mediator of the total Sex-to-Gain effect and must not be adjusted for.

variables.name: Sex
variables.content: The exposure whose total effect on weight gain is sought.

variables.name: Initial Weight
variables.content: Initial weight, a mediator of the Sex-to-Gain effect.

variables.name: Final Weight
variables.content: Final weight after the study period.

variables.name: Gain
variables.content: The deterministic outcome Y = Final Weight - Initial Weight.
